cues: Here is a quick exam habit.
Before you calculate anything, look at the form of the equation.
If x and t sit together inside one sine, the wave travels.
If they sit in separate factors, it is a stationary wave.
Then omega gives f, k gives lambda, and omega over k gives the speed.
